claims: C1 a message is converted into a sequence of tokens before being passed into the multimodal language model
C2 a token is an atomic unit of text or multimodal data, such as a word or piece of a word
C3 for the purposes of this document, tokens are an idiosyncratic unit for measuring the length of model inputs and outputs
C4 models typically have a fixed maximum number of tokens that they can input or output in a single request

concepts.name: token_definition
concepts.gloss: T is a token: an atomic unit of text or multimodal data, such as a word or piece of a word, used to measure the length of model inputs and outputs

concepts.name: message
concepts.gloss: M is a message in the conversation that is converted into a sequence of tokens before being passed into the multimodal language model

concepts.name: converted_to_tokens

concepts.name: token_sequence

concepts.inference: the text says a message is converted into a sequence of tokens; the sequence itself is presupposed as the result of that conversion

concepts.name: measures_length
concepts.gloss: tokens are used to measure the length of model input or output X

concepts.name: fixed_maximum_tokens

concepts.name: model_input_or_output
